findings.fix: Capture the exact checkpoint/directory/summary SHA returned by this invocation; restore progress only if current navigation matches that captured identity. If archive failed before returning ownership, preserve unknown current navigation and record conflict
findings.impact: Rollback can discard another writer’s valid progress navigation and silently hide its newest checkpoint, violating the promise to preserve foreign navigation
findings.observed: Real archive() fixture produced foreign checkpoint20261011-000429-8b76, then publication_guard restored progress/latest to {checkpoint:old}; foreign evidence directory retained but its navigation was overwritten
findings.title: Rollback must own the exact progress checkpoint, not every checkpoint sharing the catalog ID
findings.trigger: After publishing new candidate navigation, another valid archive() operation (its standalone caller has no DATA_WRITER lock) creates a different progress checkpoint referencing the same catalog; this acceptance then fails before receipt
findings.why_guards_do_not_prevent: The timestamp/directory/summary SHA checks identify a valid checkpoint and catalog_id identifies the candidate, but neither proves the checkpoint was returned by this invocation’s archive call; standalone archive() can update progress/latest despite this caller holding DATA_WRITER
